sources.excerpt: MXR® FAT SUGAR™ DRIVE Toggle menu Compare --> Register I Sign in Search Bag Search Close Products --> All Products --> --> Electronics MXR Cry Baby Way Huge Dunlop Electronics Authentic Hendrix Pedal Parts Electronic Parts Legacy Products Guitar Picks Tortex Nylon Max-Grip Jazz Herco Gator Grip Celluloid Ultex Primetone Delrin 500 Flow Finger & Thumb Stubby Variety Packs Artist Series Graphic Artist Series Pick Tins Other Clearance Accessories Capos Slides & Tonebars MXR Cables Care & Maintenance Strap Retainer Straps Tuners Pick Holders GrooveTech Tools Accu-Fret Fretwire Clearance Strings Artist Series Electric Bass Acoustic Classical Americana Ukulele Apparel Shirts Hoodies Hats Artists Lifestyle Sign in MXR® FAT SUGAR™ DRIVE M94SE Description The MXR Fat Sugar Drive brings the Sugar Drive’s diverse range of clear and transparent overdrive tones to MXR’s classic housing for players who prefer its footprint over that of the mini. This pedal is powered by one 9-volt battery (accessed via underside of pedal), the Dunlop ECB003 9-volt adapter, or the DC Brick™, Iso-Brick™, and Mini Iso-Brick™ power supplies.   Warranty Information The Long Story The MXR Fat Sugar Drive brings the Sugar Drive’s diverse range of clear and transparent overdrive tones to MXR’s classic housing for players who prefer its footprint over that of the mini. This pedal’s versatility comes from its unique Drive control—which replicates an amp’s transition from clean to dirty by blending your clean signal at the start of the sweep—and a little something called a voltage doubler, which increases overall headroom and opens up the sound of the pedal. Together, these elements allow you to serve up everything from a sauced-up boost to full-on blow-tube distortion. The Fat Sugar Drive is set for true bypass by default, but for the tonal purists who want buffered bypass instead, just remove the bottom plate and flick the internal Buffer switch, close it up, and get to playing. This special edition comes with a custom pink sparkle finish.
